title: IGARSS 2026 — Controlled Benchmark Poster
subtitle: A Controlled Benchmark of Visual State-Space Backbones with Domain-Shift and Boundary Analysis for Remote-Sensing Segmentation
caption: Poster presentation of our controlled benchmark of visual state-space backbones for remote-sensing segmentation at IEEE IGARSS 2026 in Washington, D.C.

images.alt: The conference poster "A Controlled Benchmark of Visual State-Space Backbones with Domain-Shift and Boundary Analysis for Remote-Sensing Segmentation", laid out in columns covering the research question, the controlled benchmark pipeline, quantitative results on LoveDA and ISPRS Potsdam, qualitative error comparisons, and accuracy-efficiency, domain-shift and boundary analyses.
images.caption: Conference poster

images.alt: The printed poster mounted on a fabric board at the IGARSS 2026 venue, seen over the shoulder of a viewer standing in front of it.
images.caption: Poster at the IGARSS 2026 venue

images.alt: A wider view of the IGARSS 2026 poster hall, with the controlled benchmark poster on the near board and further poster boards and attendees receding down the room.
images.caption: IGARSS 2026 poster session
